'''Orrin''' is a female NPC that is located in [[Ragunna]], [[Rinascita]].

From 6:00 AM - 05:59 PM, or during the daytime, she can be found chatting with [[Graham|Golem/Graham]] about business jargon near Ragunna's gate, where Acolytes handle customs.

From 6:00 PM - 5:59 AM, she can be seen near Genesis Nexus in Ragunna, in a call with someone called Lord Francois talking about [[Lollo Logistics]].

==Idle Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(during the daytime)
:'''Orrin:''' Some of your business jargon confuses me.
:'''Graham:''' Feel free to ask me anything!
----
;(at night)
:'''Orrin:''' Yes, good sir, Lollo Logistics is a trustworthy business partner.
:'''Orrin:''' We excel in confidentiality, timeliness, and security.
:'''Orrin:''' Yes, I understand your concerns. Data shows that Lollo Logistics has the lowest cargo damage rate in the industry for international shipping.
:'''Orrin:''' Averardo Bank has increased the insurance coverage for your collection by 40 million Shell Credits. What do you think?
:'''Orrin:''' I'm pleased you accepted our proposal. Looking forward to working with you, Lord Francois.
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(during the daytime)
:'''Orrin:''' Some of your business jargon confuses me.
:'''Graham:''' Feel free to ask me anything!
:'''Orrin:''' For example, what does "combination moves" mean? Does it refer to a self-defense technique used by your staff?
:'''Graham:''' Uh... here it refers to various measures working together to achieve a common goal.
:'''Orrin:''' I see! And what about "granularity"?
:'''Graham:''' You can think of it as the level of detail... How do I put this... Right! Just like ground pepper—you can grind it to coarse or fine!
:'''Orrin:''' Got it. Thank you for explaining. This "Maggie" fellow has a rather interesting way of putting things.
:'''Graham:''' Maggie...? Oh, oh! You mean my colleague, [[Maji]]!
:'''Orrin:''' I'm quite interested in his work. I'd appreciate it if you could introduce me sometime.
:'''Graham:''' It would be my pleasure. I'll let him know.
{{Dialogue End}}
